acceptance: NOT READY; draft. No merge authorized.

methodology.actions: Actual VoiceConversation with ActivityDetector/assembler, real CPU recognition engines, inert action ports, one second leading quiet and three seconds tail; each frame drained deterministically.
methodology.timing: Synthetic last-amplitude-sample proxy, excludes scheduling/IPC and inference wall time. Wake plus request has no standalone endpoint proxy. Misses/unknowns remain in denominators; null p95 is not a fast result.
methodology.fallback: Matching STT may be a draft preview and is not proof of action attribution. rescuedWithoutKeywordCandidate requires successful matching STT and absence of a recorded matching candidate. Baseline recordings without candidate instrumentation report null.
methodology.user: 18 actual microphone calibration clips, not held-out; media only in headphones or absent. Physical speech ends unannotated. Four acoustic misses recovered through STT; no general accuracy claim.
methodology.historicalComparison: Original raw 144 test excludes coordinator/leading quiet; do not compare its approximately 467 ms wake median against these coordinator medians as an improvement.

diagnosis.cause: Strict last-token-onset versus voiced-end gap rejects long syllables; acoustic failures remain. Lower thresholds/padding shuffle failures. No fuzzy Ivy or widened destructive-command boundaries adopted.
diagnosis.currentTradeoff: 1000 ms provisional action guard removes tested paused-prefix false activations; 250 ms command target not met. Speech gate recovers quiet user fallback and request tail, but expanded Prompt/New session each regress one fallback trial.
diagnosis.alternative: Unshipped small Vosk grammar experiment: contrast/longer-guard variant 92/96 expanded positives, 0/184 false activations, 11/12 user positives; no qualified replacement. Private exploratory experiment, not a supported reproducible runtime.

native.route: Explicitly user-approved recognition-smoke test feature, no debugger, microphone, playback or Ivy. Two final runs authorized and consumed.
history: Remote-debug launch automatically blocked; not retried.

limitations: Summed working sets double-count shared pages.
Idle phases keep workers warm but do not send microphone or silent keyword frames.
Other desktop applications remained running; short before/after CPU samples do not prove a reduction.
No VRAM or long-run leak measurement.
